labeling_note: Web chat/UI application with configurable models and RAG; project-owned model criteria are not applicable.

criteria.rationale: Node dependencies are declared in package.json.
package-lock.json and Docker Compose pin the environment.
Open WebUI is an application frontend, not a project-owned dataset pipeline.
Models are supplied by external providers such as Ollama; the repository does not own a model card.
The repository has a code license, but no project-owned model license.
Vitest and CI workflows provide executable verification.
No training experiment is conducted by the UI application.
Tests, CI, Docker and Make targets are present.
Prompt management UI exists, but no prompt version or hash metadata is recorded.
Model configuration is exposed, but no fixed sampling configuration is documented for a project-owned experiment.
RAG is supported, but index/embedding versions are not documented as a reproducible artifact.
MCP tools and sessions are supported, but no durable tool-call trace artifact is documented.
A split concept appears in code, but no evaluation dataset or contamination protocol is documented.
Cost is mentioned, but no reproducible project-level cost or latency measurement is provided.
